name: Time, population and ecological-outcome tables
description: Extract outcome trajectories and condition-stratified growth, survival, reporter or competition measurements; calculate declared comparisons at the resolution actually observed.

inputs.observations: identified source trajectories, distributions or summary measurements
inputs.dimensions: strain, medium, host/community state, time, population resolution and endpoint
inputs.provenance: sample/replicate IDs, units and proxy definition

outputs.table: separate lag, growth, survival, uptake, signal and competitive outcomes
outputs.coverage: time windows and cell/population resolution actually observed

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Calculate a specified temporal or condition contrast

inputs.table: selected source rows or actual point data
inputs.contrast: explicit time window, ratio/difference or group selection

outputs.limits: unobserved intervals, pooling and non-equivalent endpoints

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Reanalyze actual single-cell trajectories or flow events

inputs.data: actual events/images/lineages plus gates or tracking model
inputs.analysis: explicit gating, trajectory and calibration settings

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

repository_catalog_defined: Source access/readers are defined. No dedicated flow-cytometry, lineage, animal-study, ecological-competition or time-series analysis callable confirmed.
research_operations_performed: replacement/raw/route_bookkeeping_probe.json includes source ThyX/ThyA growth ratios; no curve fitting.
YeaG source inquiry compared recovery and delayed CFU outcomes; no FCS/lineage reanalysis.
capability_specifications_not_confirmed_: New growth-curve digitization/fitting, flow-event analysis, animal-data reanalysis and population lineage inference are unexecuted capabilities needing actual data and implementations.
author_experiments_are_source_evidence_o: Timed culture, CFU, microscopy, flow cytometry, host perturbation and microbial-community experiments are author experiments.
availability.binding_limit: A repository catalog definition is confirmed source-code identity, not proof of caller enablement, service availability, installed dependencies or execution in this research. Research scripts are retained operations, not registered runtime tools.

limits: Faster immediate regrowth need not mean greater long-term survival.
A reporter proxy is not direct metabolic flux; population heterogeneity is not tracked lineage fate.
No phenotype at one medium/time/host condition is not universal dispensability; competition and single-strain growth differ.
